name: get_actions
description:
Get list of all available ROS actions.
Example:
get_actions()

name: get_action_details
description:
Get complete action details including goal, result, and feedback structures. Requires the action type; if you don't know it, call without action_type to get the list of available types back in the error.
Example:
get_action_details('/turtle1/rotate_absolute', 'turtlesim/action/RotateAbsolute')

name: get_action_status
description:
Get action status for a specific action name. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
get_action_status('/turtle1/rotate_absolute')

name: send_action_goal
description:
Send a goal to a ROS action server. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
send_action_goal('/turtle1/rotate_absolute', 'turtlesim/action/RotateAbsolute', {'theta': 1.57})

name: cancel_action_goal
description:
Cancel a specific action goal. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
cancel_action_goal('/turtle1/rotate_absolute', 'goal_1758653551839_21acd486')

name: connect_to_robot
description: Connect to the robot by setting the IP/port. This tool also tests connectivity to confirm that the robot is reachable and the port is open.

name: ping_robots
description:
Ping one or more robot IP addresses and check if specific ports are open.
A successful ping to the IP but not the port can indicate that ROSbridge is not running.
Example:
ping_robots(targets=[{'ip': '192.168.1.100', 'port': 9090}, {'ip': '192.168.1.101', 'port': 9090}])

name: view_saved_image
description:
View a previously saved image from disk.
Images are automatically saved when subscribing to image topics.
Use this tool to re-view a saved image without re-subscribing.

name: get_nodes
description:
Get list of all currently running ROS nodes.
Example:
get_nodes()

name: get_node_details
description:
Get detailed information about a specific node including its publishers, subscribers, and services.
Example:
get_node_details('/turtlesim')

name: get_parameter
description:
Get a single ROS parameter value by name. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
get_parameter('/turtlesim:background_b')

name: set_parameter
description:
Set a single ROS parameter value. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
set_parameter('/turtlesim:background_b', '255')

name: has_parameter
description:
Check if a ROS parameter exists. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
has_parameter('/turtlesim:background_b')

name: delete_parameter
description:
Delete a ROS parameter. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
delete_parameter('/turtlesim:background_b')

name: get_parameters
description:
Get list of all ROS parameter names for a specific node. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
get_parameters('cam2image')
get_parameters('/cam2image')

name: get_parameter_details
description:
Get comprehensive details about a specific ROS parameter including value, type, and metadata. Works only with ROS 2.
Example:
get_parameter_details('/turtlesim:background_r')

name: get_verified_robot_spec
description: Load specifications and usage context for a verified robot model. ONLY use if the robot model is in the verified list (use get_verified_robots_list first to check). Most robots won't have a spec - that's OK, connect directly using connect_to_robot instead.

name: get_verified_robots_list
description: List pre-verified robot models that have specification files with usage guidance available. Use this to check if a robot model has additional context available before calling get_verified_robot_spec. If your robot is not in this list, you can still connect to it directly using connect_to_robot.

name: detect_ros_version
description: Detect the ROS version and distribution via rosbridge.

name: get_services
description:
Get list of all available ROS services.
Example:
get_services()

name: get_service_type
description:
Get the service type for a specific service.
Example:
get_service_type('/rosapi/topics')

name: get_service_details
description:
Get complete service details including request/response structures and provider nodes.
Example:
get_service_details('/rosapi/topics')

name: call_service
description:
Call a ROS service with specified request data.
Example:
call_service('/rosapi/topics', 'rosapi/Topics', {})
call_service('/slow_service', 'my_package/SlowService', {}, timeout=10.0)  # Specify timeout only for slow services

IMPORTANT: Field names in the request dict should match the field names shown by get_service_details(), which are already formatted for rosbridge (without leading underscores). For example, use {'topic': '/image'} not {'_topic': '/image'}.

name: get_topics
description:
Get list of all available ROS topics.
Example:
get_topics()

name: get_topic_type
description:
Get the message type for a specific topic.
Example:
get_topic_type('/cmd_vel')

name: get_topic_details
description:
Get detailed information about a specific topic including its type, publishers, and subscribers.
Example:
get_topic_details('/cmd_vel')

name: get_message_details
description:
Get the complete structure/definition of a message type.
Example:
get_message_details('geometry_msgs/Twist')

name: subscribe_once
description:
Subscribe to a ROS topic and return the first message received.
Example:
subscribe_once(topic='/cmd_vel', msg_type='geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped')
subscribe_once(topic='/slow_topic', msg_type='my_package/SlowMsg', timeout=10.0)  # Use longer timeout for slow topics
subscribe_once(topic='/high_rate_topic', msg_type='sensor_msgs/Image', timeout=5.0, queue_length=5, throttle_rate_ms=100)  # Control message buffering and rate
subscribe_once(topic='/camera/image_raw', msg_type='sensor_msgs/Image', expects_image='true')  # Hint that this is an image for faster processing
subscribe_once(topic='/point_cloud', msg_type='sensor_msgs/PointCloud2', expects_image='false')  # Skip image detection for non-image data

name: subscribe_for_duration
description:
Subscribe to a topic for a duration and collect messages.
Example:
subscribe_for_duration(topic='/cmd_vel', msg_type='geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped', duration=5, max_messages=10)
subscribe_for_duration(topic='/high_rate_topic', msg_type='sensor_msgs/Image', duration=10, queue_length=5, throttle_rate_ms=100)  # Control message buffering and rate
subscribe_for_duration(topic='/camera/image_raw', msg_type='sensor_msgs/Image', duration=5, expects_image='true')  # Hint that this is an image for faster processing
subscribe_for_duration(topic='/point_cloud', msg_type='sensor_msgs/PointCloud2', duration=5, expects_image='false')  # Skip image detection for non-image data

name: publish_for_durations
description:
Publish a sequence of messages to a ROS topic, each held for a given duration.
With rate_hz=0 (default): publishes each message once, then waits for the duration.
With rate_hz>0: publishes each message repeatedly at the given rate for the duration (useful for controllers like diff_drive that need continuous commands).
Example (single publish with delay):
publish_for_durations(topic='/cmd_vel', msg_type='geometry_msgs/msg/Twist', messages=[{'linear': {'x': 1.0}}, {'linear': {'x': 0.0}}], durations=[1, 2])
Example (continuous streaming at 10 Hz for 2 seconds):
publish_for_durations(topic='/cmd_vel', msg_type='geometry_msgs/msg/Twist', messages=[{'angular': {'z': 0.5}}], durations=[2.0], rate_hz=10)

name: publish_once
description:
Publish a single message to a ROS topic.
Example:
publish_once(topic='/cmd_vel', msg_type='geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped', msg={'linear': {'x': 1.0}})
